selection.method: Preselected familiar noun senses and intermediate categories in eight subject areas; no model-output-based selection.
selection.gold_policy: Every WordNet hypernyms() link with both endpoints in the case; no transitive closure, instance links, or added commonsense relations.
selection.model_input: Only case.terms; no synset identifiers, definitions, or ground-truth edges.
selection.sense_limitation: Gold senses are explicit, but the model receives ambiguous surface words; sense disagreement is a benchmark error even when another reading is plausible.

mammal.definition: any warm-blooded vertebrate having the skin more or less covered with hair; young are born alive except for the small subclass of monotremes and nourished with milk

placental.definition: mammals having a placenta; all mammals except monotremes and marsupials

carnivore.definition: a terrestrial or aquatic flesh-eating mammal

canine.definition: any of various fissiped mammals with nonretractile claws and typically long muzzles

dog.definition: a member of the genus Canis (probably descended from the common wolf) that has been domesticated by man since prehistoric times; occurs in many breeds

wolf.definition: any of various predatory carnivorous canine mammals of North America and Eurasia that usually hunt in packs

fox.definition: alert carnivorous mammal with pointed muzzle and ears and a bushy tail; most are predators that do not hunt in packs

feline.definition: any of various lithe-bodied roundheaded fissiped mammals, many with retractile claws

cat.definition: feline mammal usually having thick soft fur and no ability to roar: domestic cats; wildcats

big cat.definition: any of several large cats typically able to roar and living in the wild

lion.definition: large gregarious predatory feline of Africa and India having a tawny coat with a shaggy mane in the male

equine.definition: hoofed mammals having slender legs and a flat coat with a narrow mane along the back of the neck

horse.definition: solid-hoofed herbivorous quadruped domesticated since prehistoric times

cetacean.definition: large aquatic carnivorous mammal with fin-like forelimbs no hind limbs, including: whales; dolphins; porpoises; narwhals

whale.definition: any of the larger cetacean mammals having a streamlined body and breathing through a blowhole on the head

bat.definition: nocturnal mouselike mammal with forelimbs modified to form membranous wings and anatomical adaptations for echolocation by which they navigate

bird.definition: warm-blooded egg-laying vertebrates characterized by feathers and forelimbs modified as wings

vertebrate.definition: animals having a bony or cartilaginous skeleton with a segmented spinal column and a large brain enclosed in a skull or cranium

bird of prey.definition: any of numerous carnivorous birds that hunt and kill other animals

owl.definition: nocturnal bird of prey with hawk-like beak and claws and large head with front-facing eyes

eagle.definition: any of various large keen-sighted diurnal birds of prey noted for their broad wings and strong soaring flight

hawk.definition: diurnal bird of prey typically having short rounded wings and a long tail

duck.definition: small wild or domesticated web-footed broad-billed swimming bird usually having a depressed body and short legs

domestic fowl.definition: a domesticated gallinaceous bird thought to be descended from the red jungle fowl

chicken.definition: a domestic fowl bred for flesh or eggs; believed to have been developed from the red jungle fowl

columbiform bird.definition: a cosmopolitan order of land birds having small heads and short legs with four unwebbed toes

pigeon.definition: wild and domesticated birds having a heavy body and short legs

penguin.definition: short-legged flightless birds of cold southern especially Antarctic regions having webbed feet and wings modified as flippers

passerine.definition: perching birds mostly small and living near the ground with feet having 4 toes arranged to allow for gripping the perch; most are songbirds; hatchlings are helpless

sparrow.definition: any of several small dull-colored singing birds feeding on seeds or insects

vehicle.definition: a conveyance that transports people or objects

wheeled vehicle.definition: a vehicle that moves on wheels and usually has a container for transporting things or people

motor vehicle.definition: a self-propelled wheeled vehicle that does not run on rails

car.definition: a motor vehicle with four wheels; usually propelled by an internal combustion engine

truck.definition: an automotive vehicle suitable for hauling

motorcycle.definition: a motor vehicle with two wheels and a strong frame

bicycle.definition: a wheeled vehicle that has two wheels and is moved by foot pedals

public transport.definition: conveyance for passengers or mail or freight

bus.definition: a vehicle carrying many passengers; used for public transport

train.definition: public transport provided by a line of railway cars coupled together and drawn by a locomotive

vessel.definition: a craft designed for water transportation

boat.definition: a small vessel for travel on water

ship.definition: a vessel that carries passengers or freight

heavier-than-air craft.definition: a non-buoyant aircraft that requires a source of power to hold it aloft and to propel it

airplane.definition: an aircraft that has a fixed wing and is powered by propellers or jets

helicopter.definition: an aircraft without wings that obtains its lift from the rotation of overhead blades

food.definition: any substance that can be metabolized by an animal to give energy and build tissue

produce.definition: fresh fruits and vegetable grown for the market

vegetable.definition: edible seeds or roots or stems or leaves or bulbs or tubers or nonsweet fruits of any of numerous herbaceous plant

root vegetable.definition: any of various fleshy edible underground roots or tubers

carrot.definition: orange root; important source of carotene

potato.definition: an edible tuber native to South America; a staple food of Ireland

edible fruit.definition: edible reproductive body of a seed plant especially one having sweet flesh

apple.definition: fruit with red or yellow or green skin and sweet to tart crisp whitish flesh

citrus.definition: any of numerous fruits of the genus Citrus having thick rind and juicy pulp; grown in warm regions

orange.definition: round yellow to orange fruit of any of several citrus trees

lemon.definition: yellow oval fruit with juicy acidic flesh

baked goods.definition: foods (like breads and cakes and pastries) that are cooked in an oven

bread.definition: food made from dough of flour or meal and usually raised with yeast or baking powder and then baked

starches.definition: foodstuff rich in natural starch (especially potatoes, rice, bread)

grain.definition: foodstuff prepared from the starchy grains of cereal grasses

rice.definition: grains used as food either unpolished or more often polished

musical instrument.definition: any of various devices or contrivances that can be used to produce musical tones or sounds

stringed instrument.definition: a musical instrument in which taut strings provide the source of sound

bowed stringed instrument.definition: stringed instruments that are played with a bow

guitar.definition: a stringed instrument usually having six strings; played by strumming or plucking

violin.definition: bowed stringed instrument that is the highest member of the violin family; this instrument has four strings and a hollow body and an unfretted fingerboard and is played with a bow

cello.definition: a large stringed instrument; seated player holds it upright while playing

keyboard instrument.definition: a musical instrument that is played by means of a keyboard

piano.definition: a keyboard instrument that is played by depressing keys that cause hammers to strike tuned strings and produce sounds

wind instrument.definition: a musical instrument in which the sound is produced by an enclosed column of air that is moved by the breath

woodwind.definition: any wind instrument other than the brass instruments

flute.definition: a high-pitched woodwind instrument; a slender tube closed at one end with finger holes on one end and an opening near the closed end across which the breath is blown

brass instrument.definition: a wind instrument that consists of a brass tube (usually of variable length) that is blown by means of a cup-shaped or funnel-shaped mouthpiece

trumpet.definition: a brass musical instrument with a brilliant tone; has a narrow tube and a flared bell and is played by means of valves

trombone.definition: a brass instrument consisting of a long tube whose length can be varied by a U-shaped slide

percussion instrument.definition: a musical instrument in which the sound is produced by one object striking another

drum.definition: a musical percussion instrument; usually consists of a hollow cylinder with a membrane stretched across each end

body part.definition: any part of an organism such as an organ or extremity

organ.definition: a fully differentiated structural and functional unit in an animal that is specialized for some particular function

internal organ.definition: a main organ that is situated inside the body

heart.definition: the hollow muscular organ located behind the sternum and between the lungs; its rhythmic contractions move the blood through the body

liver.definition: large and complicated reddish-brown glandular organ located in the upper right portion of the abdominal cavity; secretes bile and functions in metabolism of protein and carbohydrate and fat; synthesizes substances involved in the clotting of the blood; synthesizes vitamin A; detoxifies poisonous substances and breaks down worn-out erythrocytes

excretory organ.definition: an organ that separates waste substances from the blood and discharges them

kidney.definition: either of two bean-shaped excretory organs that filter wastes (especially urea) from the blood and excrete them and water in urine

respiratory organ.definition: any organ involved in the process of respiration

lung.definition: either of two saclike respiratory organs in the chest of vertebrates; serves to remove carbon dioxide and provide oxygen to the blood

blood vessel.definition: a vessel in which blood circulates

artery.definition: a blood vessel that carries blood from the heart to the body

vein.definition: a blood vessel that carries blood from the capillaries toward the heart

connective tissue.definition: tissue of mesodermal origin consisting of e.g. collagen fibroblasts and fatty cells; supports organs and fills spaces between them and forms tendons and ligaments

bone.definition: rigid connective tissue that makes up the skeleton of vertebrates

skin.definition: a natural protective body covering and site of the sense of touch

body covering.definition: any covering for the body or a body part

worker.definition: a person who works at a specific occupation

skilled worker.definition: a worker who has acquired special skills

professional.definition: a person engaged in one of the learned professions

health professional.definition: a person who helps in identifying or preventing or treating illness or disability

surgeon.definition: a physician who specializes in surgery

dentist.definition: a person qualified to practice dentistry

nurse.definition: one skilled in caring for young children or the sick (usually under the supervision of a physician)

teacher.definition: a person whose occupation is teaching

craftsman.definition: a skilled worker who practices some trade or handicraft

carpenter.definition: a woodworker who makes or repairs wooden objects

electrician.definition: a person who installs or repairs electrical or telephone lines

machine.definition: any mechanical or electrical device that transmits or modifies energy to perform or assist in the performance of human tasks

computer.definition: a machine for performing calculations automatically

portable computer.definition: a personal computer that can easily be carried by hand

laptop.definition: a portable computer small enough to use in your lap

personal computer.definition: a small digital computer based on a microprocessor and designed to be used by one person at a time

desktop computer.definition: a personal computer small enough to fit conveniently in an individual workspace

server.definition: (computer science) a computer that provides client stations with access to files and printers as shared resources to a computer network

software.definition: (computer science) written programs or procedures or rules and associated documentation pertaining to the operation of a computer system and that are stored in read/write memory

code.definition: (computer science) the symbolic arrangement of data or instructions in a computer program or the set of such instructions

operating system.definition: (computer science) software that controls the execution of computer programs and may provide various services

program.definition: (computer science) a sequence of instructions that a computer can interpret and execute

compiler.definition: (computer science) a program that decodes instructions written in a higher order language and produces an assembly language program

interpreter.definition: (computer science) a program that translates and executes source language statements one line at a time

device.definition: an instrumentality invented for a particular purpose

keyboard.definition: device consisting of a set of keys on a piano or organ or typewriter or typesetting machine or computer or the like
